name: http-endpoints
source: OpenCTI-Platform/opencti@c9f5ea5 (opencti-platform/opencti-graphql/src/http, graphql/sseMiddleware.js and every file that adds a route)
intro: The 48 HTTP endpoints OpenCTI 7.260811.0-lts.1 serves, the GraphQL API included. Paths are relative to the base path (`app:base_path`, empty by default), except `/metrics` on the Prometheus port, and use the Express syntax: `:id` is one segment, `*file` the rest of the path. *Token or session* means an `Authorization: Bearer` header (an API token, or a JWT signed by OpenCTI or a trusted XTM platform), a Basic login or the cookie of a browser session; a rate limiter (`app:rate_protection`) applies to every request on the platform port, except WebSocket connections and the IPs and user agents its skip lists name. Share data through these endpoints as [Feeds, TAXII collections and streams](/opencti/use/share/feeds/) explains; probe the platform as [Health probes](/deploy/operate/health-probes/) explains.

sections.title: Health and metrics
sections.text: `/health` answers on the platform port. The other endpoints of this table listen on a port of their own: `/metrics` once `app:telemetry:metrics:enabled` is `true` (its port, `app:telemetry:metrics:exporter_prometheus`, is 14269 by default), and the liveness probe, where the version has one, once `app:liveness_port` is set.

cells: Health of the platform and of its dependencies: `200` when healthy, `503` otherwise.
Access key (`health_access_key` query parameter), none when `app:health_access_key` is `public`
